final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 12.88 bn in Q2 2025, up 5.1% from SAR 12.25 bn in Q2 2024. Average weekly transactions were 216.9 million (up 11.9%), and the average ticket was SAR 59.4 (down 6.1%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 472 mn; Gas Stations increased by SAR 80 mn; Jewelry increased by SAR 63 mn.
